selected_model.selection_reason: RMSE within 2% of best validation candidate and 90% interval coverage closest to 0.90 among eligible candidates.

interpretation.disagreement: Surrogate-to-live-VLA action mismatch in normalized Y coordinates; equals observed GP action residual when the target is the same VLA output.
interpretation.uncertainty: Conditional GP predictive spread including fixed observation noise; not VLA epistemic uncertainty or task failure probability.
interpretation.threshold_status: Exploratory request-only thresholds, not validated risk thresholds.
interpretation.calibrated_intervals: Validation multiplier is descriptive; no independent-episode conformal guarantee.
